skill.name: notion-research-documentation
skill.description: Research Notion workspaces and produce cited briefs, summaries, comparisons, and reports through Notion MCP workflows.
skill.summary: Turns Notion research sources into cited documentation and decision-ready reports.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives caused by Markdown inline code for Notion tools and reference paths. The real risks are setup instructions that can change Codex MCP configuration, connect to a hardcoded Notion endpoint, and start OAuth login. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running Codex MCP setup commands, enabling remote MCP, or starting Notion OAuth login.
Document why the Notion MCP endpoint is required and tell users to verify the endpoint and requested permissions before connecting.

remediation.issue: Referenced support folders may be missing
remediation.suggestion: Include the referenced templates and examples in the package, or remove those references from the skill instructions.

content.value_statement: Teams often need to turn scattered Notion pages into reliable briefs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through source search, synthesis, and cited Notion documentation.
actual_capabilities: Guides targeted Notion searches and asks the user to confirm scope when results are unclear.
Fetches relevant Notion pages through MCP and extracts facts, metrics, claims, constraints, and dates.
Helps choose quick brief, research summary, comparison, or comprehensive report formats.
Creates Notion pages with summaries, key findings, evidence, recommendations, and next steps.
Adds source links, inline citations, references, changelogs, and status updates for revised pages.
limitations: Requires a connected Notion MCP server and OAuth login before Notion tools can work.
Can only access pages allowed by the connected Notion account and integration permissions.
Referenced template and example folders may be unavailable in this package.
Research quality depends on complete source pages, accurate facts, and careful citation review.

use_cases.title: Prepare stakeholder briefs
use_cases.description: Turn related Notion notes into a short cited brief with findings, source links, and open questions.

use_cases.title: Compare documented options
use_cases.description: Review Notion pages about vendors, projects, or approaches and produce a structured comparison report.

use_cases.title: Document research decisions
use_cases.description: Build a comprehensive Notion report that connects evidence, risks, recommendations, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Quick research brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a quick Notion brief about [topic]. Search Notion first, ask me to confirm the scope, and include source links.

prompt_templates.title: Thematic research summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] across relevant Notion pages. Fetch the strongest sources, group findings by theme, and produce a cited summary page.

prompt_templates.title: Evidence-based comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] using Notion sources. Show evidence, tradeoffs, open questions, and a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Comprehensive decision report
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an executive-ready Notion report on [decision]. Use multiple sources, note contradictions, cite evidence inline, and include next steps and risks.

output_examples.input: Ask for a quick readout on customer feedback themes stored in Notion.
output_examples.output: A short Notion brief with confirmed scope, top themes, source links, evidence notes, and open questions.

output_examples.input: Compare two vendor options documented in internal Notion pages.
output_examples.output: A comparison page with criteria, evidence summaries, tradeoffs, risks, a recommendation, and references.

output_examples.input: Update a prior research page after new Notion notes arrive.
output_examples.output: A revised page with a short changelog, updated findings, new citations, and changed conclusions clearly marked.

best_practices: Confirm the research scope before fetching many Notion pages.
Track each source URL or page ID while collecting evidence.
Review citations, permissions, and sensitive content before publishing the final page.
anti_patterns: Do not create a report from a single weak source when more Notion evidence is available.
Do not run MCP setup or OAuth commands without explicit user approval.
Do not present uncertain findings as final decisions without noting gaps or contradictions.

faq.question: Does this skill require Notion MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs a connected Notion MCP server and permissions for the pages you want to research.

faq.question: Can it create pages in Notion?
faq.answer: Yes, when Notion MCP allows page creation and the user approves the destination.

faq.question: Does it include citation guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks for source URLs or IDs, inline citations, and a references section.

faq.question: Can it access every workspace page?
faq.answer: No. It can only access pages available through the connected Notion account and integration permissions.

faq.question: Can I use it for comparisons?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports comparison reports with tradeoffs, evidence, risks, and recommendations.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing?
faq.answer: Review source accuracy, permissions, sensitive content, and any OAuth or MCP setup commands.
